editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: Prepared for those who want to enter the field of artificial intelligence engineering (AI engineering), this resource aims to teach end-to-end application development processes using Python. This study, which puts theoretical knowledge into practice, covers the design and deployment of artificial intelligence-based software.

items.title: elder-plinius/G0DM0D3
items.summary: G0DM0D3 is a liberated AI chat interface that aims to bypass the security layers of large language models. Developed with TypeScript, this open source project allows users to interact with models without restrictions.

items.title: KnockOutEZ/wigolo
items.summary: Wigolo is a tool that provides local-first search, data extraction and crawling capabilities for artificial intelligence coding agents. This system, which works over the model context protocol (MCP), provides free research without cloud dependency and without requiring an API key.

items.title: MoonshotAI/kimi-cli
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi CLI is an artificial intelligence agent that works via a command line interface (CLI). This Python-based tool is designed to automate command line interactions in software development processes.

items.title: LG monitors silently install software through Windows Update without consent
items.summary: LG monitors install software in the background via Windows Update without user approval. This brings up security and user control discussions regarding the inclusion of additional applications in the system as well as hardware drivers.

items.title: GPT-5.6 used a prompt to close a 30-year gap in convex optimization
items.summary: Artificial intelligence models have solved a mathematical problem that has not been solved for thirty years in the field of convex optimization with the help of a simple command. This development demonstrates the capacity of large language models to make logical inferences from complex mathematical proofs.

items.title: Mayor Mamdani Says Landlords Can't Use AI Images to Advertise
items.summary: Mayor Mamdani introduced a regulation banning landlords from secretly using AI-generated images in rental property listings. This application aims to increase visual transparency in housing advertisements and prevent digital manipulation.

items.title: Speech Recognition and TTS in less than 500kb
items.summary: The Moonshine project offers speech recognition and text-to-speech models with a size of less than 500 kilobytes. These lightweight frameworks enable native language processing capabilities on systems with limited hardware resources.

items.title: If You Build It, They Will Come
items.summary: It is argued that creating a user base in software projects is directly related to marketing and community interaction rather than the technical quality of the product. It is emphasized that developers should focus on user acquisition strategies rather than a product-oriented approach.
